messages:
Alex P: Coffee machine's running on E empty pods and oat milk is low. Anyone heading out for a food run ~12:30? Also, pantry granola bars are gone.
Samira: I can do a run at 12:30. Need specific brands or counts? :coffee: :+1:
Alex P: Awesome — 1 box regular pods, 1 box decaf, 1 oat milk carton, peanut butter jar, and green tea sachets. If you see granola bars, restock those too.
Devon: If you're passing Bluebird, could you nab 3 gluten-free muffins? Maya loves them.
Maya: 3 muffins pls :) I’ll Venmo Samira my share. :raised_hands: 
Samira: Quick q — company card or we split?
Chris: Use company card for snacks, label receipts with REDWOOD-KITCHEN-23. Also fridge note: please label personal containers or they'll be tossed after 72h. Left a sticky note on the fridge.
Alex P: Good call on labels. And please no yogurt lids as spoon holders 😅
supply-bot: supply-bot: Inventory check — coffee_pods_regular=2, coffee_pods_decaf=0, oat_milk=1, sugar=5. Auto-reorder is off. Use `/order-snacks` to trigger a restock.
Samira: I'll run the command when I get back. Command I'm going to use:
```
/order-snacks add "coffee_pods_regular" 1
/order-snacks add "coffee_pods_decaf" 1
/order-snacks add "oat_milk" 2
/order-snacks add "granola_bars" 2
```
Devon: I'll grab the muffins and maybe a hummus tub.
Maya: Hummus please, small container.
Alex P: If anyone wants chips or sparkling water add here.
Samira: Picking up chips (BBQ) and sparkling lemon water. ETA 12:55. :sunglasses: 
Chris: Reminder to upload receipts to #finance and mark with REDWOOD-KITCHEN-23.
Samira: Will upload receipt + photo of stock.
Alex P: Thanks team! Kitchen points: can we add a tiny sign on the shelf for "Company snacks — please sign if you take"? Simple paper will do.
Devon: I'll print one and stick it up.
Maya: Love it. Thanks Samira! :yum:
Samira: Back at 12:58, restocked and ran `/order-snacks` — left a note on the shelf with what I bought.
